# Method comparison tool: Passing-Bablok, Deming regression and Bland-Altman

> Free online method comparison for two measurement methods on the same samples (a new assay against the current one, an analyser against the reference lab, a cuff against mercury). Gives Passing-Bablok regression (Passing & Bablok 1983) with its rank-based confidence intervals and CUSUM linearity test, Deming regression (Cornbleet & Gochman 1979) and weighted Deming for proportional error (Linnet 1990) with jackknife intervals, Bland-Altman bias and limits of agreement with their intervals (Bland & Altman 1986, 1999), Kendall's tau-b, and the difference between the methods at decision levels. Passing-Bablok runs on up to 20,000 pairs by counting slopes with merge-sort inversions instead of listing them. On 4,212 NHANES 2017-2018 adults, the oscillometric cuff read systolic pressure 1.3 mmHg below mercury on average, least squares gave a slope of 0.87 and Passing-Bablok 1.023. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). A statistical estimate, not medical, laboratory accreditation or regulatory advice. One value per method per sample. Reads comma, tab, space and semicolon-separated text; a semicolon file (Excel's CSV in most of Europe) may use decimal commas (4,1;4,3). A missing reading is an error, not a zero.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/method-comparison/)

## Use it from code

- `node cli.mjs pairs.csv [--x COL --y COL] [--lambda R | --sd-x S --sd-y S] [--levels 120,140] [--percent]`
- `--csv` for one row per pair with both fits and the difference, `--json` for everything.
- `node platform/agents/tools.mjs call method-comparison analyze --input '{"x":[4.1,5,5.6,6.3,7.1,7.9],"y":[4.3,5.4,5.8,6.9,7.4,8.6],"decisionLevels":[6]}'`
- From JavaScript: `analyze({text, decisionLevels, lambda})`, or the pieces: `passingBablok(x, y)`, `demingJackknife(x, y, lambda)`, `weightedDeming(x, y, lambda)`, `blandAltman(x, y)`.

## What it answers

- Do the old and new methods agree, and is the difference constant or proportional?
- What is the Passing-Bablok slope and intercept with confidence intervals?
- What is the Deming regression slope when both methods have measurement error?
- What are the Bland-Altman limits of agreement and their confidence intervals?
- How far apart are the methods at a medical decision level?
- Is the relationship between the methods linear?
